[[Donal's brother]] and his family owned a '''farm''' near the town of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The man and his family were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Fa'athra gang]] after they were unable to pay protection money, and the criminals took over the farm as their base until an individual hired by [[Donal (Nal Hutta)|Donal]] attacked the farm. The individual also retrieved a lockbox of valuables from the farm, which Donal gave as payment.<ref name="TOR" />
